sections.title: Overview
descriptions: This page brings together available employment and compensation records related to Cayden J. Boothe.
He worked for the American Fork Police Department for 3 years, after which he joined the Lynchburg Police Department in Virginia.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Boothe worked for the American Fork Police Department from February 10, 2020 to July 5, 2023. After leaving the American Fork Police Department, Cayden J. Boothe joined the Lynchburg Police Department in Virginia. He was sworn in on December 15, 2023, and public payroll records list him as a Lynchburg police officer through at least 2025.
